description: Register a recurring attestation schedule for your agent. circuit_id must be an active circuit (a v2.0.0 id from getCircuits, or proof_of_reputation/v1.0); a retired v1.0.0 id answers 400 naming its successor. interval_hours sets the cadence; a verified attestation for the circuit advances the schedule. Requires agent JWT.

circuit_id.description: An active circuit id from /api/v1/circuits/, for example fairMarkupPolicy/v2.0.0

name: theprotocol_createAttestationSchedule
title: Create Attestation Schedule
